English: Standing Stone
A solitary monolith raised by the clan as a first marker of settlement, serving as a gathering point and symbol of unity.
Mossy Boulder
A large boulder, cleared and marked by the clan, used for tribal meetings and simple rituals, strengthening communal ties.
Carved Slab
A large flat stone, carved with tribal symbols and clan history, used for storytelling and instructing the young.
Circle of Stones
A complete stone circle, providing a sacred space for major clan gatherings and seasonal rites, embodying tribal unity.
Altar Stone
A central altar stone within the circle, used by druids for sacred rituals, greatly enhancing clan unity and religious authority.
Marked Menhir
A towering menhir, inscribed with clan victories and symbols, inspiring loyalty and pride among all members.
Sanctuary Circle
An expanded sacred enclosure, reserved for rituals, feasts, and dispute resolution
Priests Stone
A grand ceremonial stone reserved for the clans high priest or druid, radiating spiritual authority and uniting the faithful.
High Druidic Ring
A masterfully constructed stone ring, where the clans greatest leaders and druids convene, strengthening unity and tradition.
Celtic Stone Sanctuary
A legendary sanctuary of stone—center of all clan gatherings, druidic rites, and seasonal festivals—ensuring the immortality and unity of the tribe.
